Looking forward to seeing more.8/10.Terrific!!Power is a great edge of your seat thriller that will keep your entertained throughout the entire series. The acting and the writing were so good that the show just sucked you into their world. The character development is as good as any show on television. Even though these are criminals you're watching you really start to care for them and root for them. This show really takes off on season two, the show just keeps getting better and better that the next thing you k is is that you'll want to binge the entire series as quickly as possible. Even though the ending was terrible it doesn't change the fact that it was still a very good show. This is the only show in history that was so well liked that it got not one, but FOUR spin-offs!Time to throw in the towelI have enjoyed Power since day one. It's been a thrilling ride with a lot if intrigues, drama and action. The storyline has been exciting and fun the whole time. Always leaving the audience wanting more. Until now.Season 6 started of great! But it's starting to loose it's way after episode 10. It's time to throw in the towel ,while still ahead. Saving the show's integrity. It's been a blast , but the writing is getting lazy and it's to much jumping back and forth. Im getting impatient! With that said I would recommend this show anytime ! Tommy Egan for president!Great Show!I absolutely loved Power. Every season just kept stepping up their game. The best part of the show is the relationship between Ghost (Omari Hardwick) and Tommy (Joseph Sikora). Tommy steals every scene he's in. He was so liked that he got his own show. The show follows Ghost, a man living a double life of leading a drug empire and owning one of the most successful night clubs in the city. He uses that night club to launder money and only wants to do it long enough to get out of the drug game and go legitimate but his best friend Tommy doesn't. Tommy wants to be the only thing he ever knew and that's a gangster. Some of the writing in this show is unbelievable but that doesn't take away from the fact that the show is fantastic.
